change_control: Never overwrite this v1 contract. Any necessary design change gets a new version and rationale before model selection/test scoring; keep the old contract. Register exact search spaces/budgets before search and final model settings before test.

crf_fallback.report: Identify fallback explicitly; no switching based on CV/dev/test performance.
crf_fallback.trigger: A training-only timing pilot predicts >4 CPU hours for the registered 5-fold search; log estimate and switch before viewing search scores.

classical.features: F3 gold POS/chunk is research-only; deployment variants use raw-text-available features.
classical.leakage_rule: Fit vectorizers, learned vocabularies, scalers, SVD/PCA, K-means and all other learned transforms only on the fit portion of each fold. Refit selected transforms/model on train, never dev/test.
classical.selection: Mean of held-out fold micro entity F1, not token accuracy; report fold std (ddof=1).
classical.tie_break: First configuration in the pre-registered simpler-to-more-complex search order.

metric_contract.bootstrap: 2000 sentence-level draws with replacement, 95% percentile intervals, NumPy default_rng seed 2026; sum TP/FP/FN then compute corpus metrics.
metric_contract.gold: Original metadata-decoded IOB2; invalid gold or mismatched sentence/token lengths raises an error.
metric_contract.missing_types: Always output PER/ORG/LOC/MISC; undefined precision, recall or F1 is 0, with explicit support and denominator counts.
metric_contract.paired: B minus A on identical sentence indices per draw; require identical ids, tokens and gold. An interval excluding zero is descriptive evidence, not a calibrated p-value.
metric_contract.prediction: Before all scoring, an I-X not preceded by B-X/I-X becomes B-X. Other tags unchanged. Same fixed rule for every system; preserve raw tags and count repairs.
metric_contract.primary: Micro entity precision/recall/F1; exact start, exclusive end and type, within each original sentence.
metric_contract.rationale: Matches development-document Step 9 orphan-I extraction rule; does not inspect gold labels. Boundary/type matching remains exact.
metric_contract.scale: All metrics and confidence limits are fractions in [0,1]; paired differences in [-1,1].
metric_contract.seqeval: 1.2.2, mode=strict, scheme=IOB2, zero_division=0; independently checked against span counts.
metric_contract.uncertainty_scope: Conditional on fixed trained models and sentence resampling; does not include training-seed variance or within-document dependence.

prediction_schema.alignment: Exactly one row per original sentence, one tag per original word. Reassemble Transformer chunks first.

fields.raw_pred_tags: unaltered model tag strings before the fixed orphan-I rule

prediction_schema.sidecar: schema/metric version, system, split, protocol hash, counts and JSONL SHA-256; no overwrite.
prediction_schema.test_use: Write final test predictions only after final settings are frozen; re-use saved files for bootstrap, never retrain during resampling.

split_usage.test: Only after final settings/checkpoints and comparison list are frozen. Score each final checkpoint once; save predictions for all later uncertainty analysis. No tuning or error-driven changes.
split_usage.train: All fitting. Classical hyperparameters use the saved 5 contiguous document-safe training folds.
split_usage.validation: Compare methods/features; choose Transformer hyperparameters/checkpoints/early stopping; perform all error analysis.

status: frozen experimental design; model-specific grids must be registered before their search
step4_scope: Real data integrity/fold generation only. Metric/bootstrap/prediction-file demonstrations are synthetic. No real model predictions or test scores are generated.

transformer.preprocessing: Accepted Step 3 first-subword supervision; reconstruct original sentences before scoring.
transformer.reason: Full K-fold fine-tuning is too costly; held-out development selection plus independent seed repeats.
transformer.report: Report all three seeds and mean/sample std (ddof=1). Never select the best test seed.
transformer.selection: Tune on validation with seed 42, freeze settings, then repeat the chosen setting for seeds 42/52/62. Each seed selects its checkpoint by validation F1.

uncertainty.paired_rule: Same original sentence indices for A and B; resample saved predictions, no refitting.
preplanned_primary_pairs: selected deployable CRF vs BERT seed 42
uncertainty.report: B-minus-A intervals on corpus micro F1. Per-type comparisons exploratory; intervals are not multiple-comparison corrected or training-variance intervals.
